entities.name: Juan Lindo y Zelaya

entities.summary: Juan Nepomuceno Fernández Lindo y Zelaya, generally known as Juan Lindo, was a conservative Central American politician, provisional president of the Republic of El Salvador from 1841 to 1842, and President of the Republic of Honduras from 1847 to 1852.
